owner_points.point: R05 asks for packaged FOM modules; the repository's rules refuse the five RPR XML modules and the OpenRTI archive anywhere in the tree.
owner_points.ruling: Recorded deviation: the modules and the archive are never in the repository or the wheel; the release evidence kit supplies them, SYNAPSE_HLA_FOM_DIR names their directory and every module is checked against pins.json before use.

owner_points.point: R12's literal evokeMultipleCallbacks(0.0, 0.05) returns at once when nothing is pending and keeps a processor busy.
owner_points.ruling: The literal parameters are kept; after a call that delivered no callback the worker pauses 5 ms. Changing R12's parameters is the owner's call.

owner_points.point: Through the pinned OpenRTI a subscription at PhysicalEntity reaches only federates that publish PhysicalEntity itself; a publisher at GroundVehicle alone is never discovered, so the demo as written yields no observation.
owner_points.ruling: The synthetic publisher publishes the four attributes at PhysicalEntity and at GroundVehicle and registers at GroundVehicle; the observer is unchanged. README, installation guide and evidence report state the limitation.

owner_points.point: On macOS a C++14 OpenRTI client cannot connect (two clocks with different origins inside OpenRTI).
owner_points.ruling: Linux keeps R43 exactly; on macOS OpenRTI alone is built as C++98 and the worker and publisher stay C++14; macOS results are development evidence only.

owner_points.point: An orderly RTI exit (rtinode ends, or FIN) gives no connectionLost; OpenRTI removes every known object instead.
owner_points.ruling: Both are handled: a reset is E_RTI_CONNECT with the 1/2/4 s retry; an orderly close gives one removal per known object and the generation stays open. Last-received values are never claimed to be kept.

owner_points.point: The interoperability field has three spellings in the handoff.
owner_points.ruling: external_customer_interoperability everywhere (run.json, demo.json, the evidence report), NOT_TESTED unless a witnessed report exists.

owner_points.point: No E_ code is mapped to an exit class; the exit of a COMPLETE capture with a recovered error is undetermined.
owner_points.ruling: Codes mapped to classes 2 to 6; the exit is the highest class of the terminal failures, else 3 for any E_ diagnostic, else 0; usage errors are a structured E_CONFIG with exit 2.

owner_points.point: The endpoint pattern admits non-canonical hosts.
owner_points.ruling: Semantic validation: a canonical dotted quad with octets up to 255 and a port 1 to 65535.

owner_points.point: A-UNSUBSCRIBED, A-RETRACT and A-EMPTY cannot be produced through the pinned RTI.
owner_points.ruling: A test harness drives the worker's own callback code inside an OpenRTI federation of its own process; those cases are bound to its scenarios.

owner_points.point: The fixed limits are unreachable at their real values in a test.
owner_points.ruling: A test-only seam lowers one limit while keeping the rest; no option, key or variable reaches a limit; the real values are held to the table.

owner_points.point: E_TIME_REGRESSION and E_GEODESY cannot arise from valid data.
owner_points.ruling: Both are reached through direct calls and crafted inputs and keep their table behaviour.

owner_points.point: requirements.json and the gates carry only the first paragraph of each requirement.
owner_points.ruling: A paragraph map assigns every continuation paragraph and table to its requirements; a gate is bound only when its tests name every paragraph mapped to it.

owner_points.point: SPEC:20 says CMake 3.28 or later; CMake 4 refuses OpenRTI's minimum version.
owner_points.ruling: The handoff's command byte for byte on 3.28 to 3.31; -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 only on 4.x, recorded in the build record; 4.x is development use.

owner_points.point: The handoff's licence note says LGPL-2.1-or-later and points to COPYING files the archive does not have; the archive offers LGPL-2.1, LGPL-3.0 or MPL-2.0.
owner_points.ruling: The release carries the archive's LICENSE and the three licence texts verbatim and elects LGPL-2.1-or-later, dynamically linked, with the pinned archive shipped alongside; the SBOM records the system expat and zlib.

owner_points.point: The handoff's geodesy tool prints a fixed PROJ version string whatever ran.
owner_points.ruling: Evidence records the PROJ version cs2cs states at run time, never a copied string.

owner_points.point: The supplied vectors leave whole classes of decoder and geodesy mistakes undetected.
owner_points.ruling: Hand-derived vectors were added for every slot of every variant, every interpreted offset and non-trivial latitudes and longitudes.

owner_points.point: Rounding of emitted floats is not specified to the bit.
owner_points.ruling: CPython's round of the binary64 value, ties to even.

owner_points.point: What the kinematics object holds below the course threshold.
owner_points.ruling: Kinematics is kept below the 1e-6 m/s threshold with course_deg null, and the ENU step is listed.

owner_points.point: Longitude +180 and the ENU basis at the antimeridian.
owner_points.ruling: A literal +180 is written -180; ENU uses the unwrapped atan2.

owner_points.point: The iteration's converged latitude and its last step.
owner_points.ruling: The converged latitude is the last next value; convergence on the 32nd step counts; N is recomputed at the final latitude.

owner_points.point: Negative zero in decoded and projected values.
owner_points.ruling: -0.0 is kept in attributes.hla.spatial and normalised only in position and kinematics.

owner_points.point: The order of suppression reasons.
owner_points.ruling: Reasons are unique and sorted in code-point order.

owner_points.point: A generation_start whose federation_name differs from the configuration's.
owner_points.ruling: Refused by verify, the reader and the chain as E_CAPTURE_SCHEMA at line:<n>#/event/federation_name.

owner_points.point: What a prefix replay's capture.jsonl holds.
owner_points.ruling: The whole input file, unverified tail included, with its SHA-256; the summary's verification member says how far verification read.

owner_points.point: A quarantined token that keeps asserting an identity.
owner_points.ruling: No diagnostic and no claim (the catalogue is closed); the snapshot shows the quarantine.

owner_points.point: Which objects generation_end invalidates.
owner_points.ruling: Every non-removed object with an allocated entity_id, whether or not it ever produced an Entity.

owner_points.point: How often a geography error is emitted.
owner_points.ruling: E_ECEF_RANGE or E_GEODESY on every snapshot that lists GEOGRAPHY_UNPROJECTABLE and no MISSING_ or INVALID_ reason, under time policy none too.

owner_points.point: A vertical ECEF velocity at longitude +-180 or +-90 gains a horizontal component from roundoff.
owner_points.ruling: SPEC:146 as written, no clipping threshold (R31 forbids one); a course appears above about 1e10 m/s.

owner_points.point: Bytes after a verified footer.
owner_points.ruling: E_CAPTURE_SCHEMA, never INCOMPLETE: such a file has no prefix replay (stricter than RED-06's text).

owner_points.point: Replay of a FAILED capture without allow_prefix.
owner_points.ruling: Refused as E_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE at line:<footer>#/status; an INCOMPLETE capture whose header did not verify is refused even with allow_prefix.

owner_points.point: A header configuration that fails a semantic rule.
owner_points.ruling: The capture is INVALID (verify reports, replay raises); schema faults of the header's config are E_CAPTURE_SCHEMA, semantic faults E_CONFIG; captures recorded before a later tightening of the configuration rules become unreplayable.

owner_points.point: A carriage return in a configuration file.
owner_points.ruling: A raw CR is refused (E_CONFIG with a line path), so a CRLF-saved configuration is refused.

owner_points.point: "Sorted ASCII property names" when a key is not ASCII.
owner_points.ruling: Python's code-point key order of the named json.dumps call; only header pin keys can be non-ASCII.

owner_points.point: The encoding of a FOM module.
owner_points.ruling: Strict UTF-8, no NUL, an XML declaration naming UTF-8 or none; expat is created with UTF-8 so the codec registry is never consulted.

owner_points.point: R15: the audit time never affects the output; but the hash chain covers the header's record_created_at.
owner_points.ruling: Held as: identical state, identity, values and diagnostics, observations differing only in source_hash.

owner_points.point: Retractable callbacks on unknown or removed tokens.
owner_points.ruling: Only E_UNKNOWN_OBJECT or W_DUPLICATE_REMOVE (there is no object to quarantine); adding E_RETRACTION_UNSUPPORTED is a possible other reading.

owner_points.point: The retraction footer: NAT-08's table says FAILED, RED-08 says COMPLETE.
owner_points.ruling: RED-08 wins: E_RETRACTION_UNSUPPORTED, generation_end retraction, footer COMPLETE with reason_code null, exit 3.

owner_points.point: A worker that cannot be started again in mid-session (RED-01 does not list it).
owner_points.ruling: A captured generation-0 E_DEPENDENCY_PIN, never retried, footer FAILED E_DEPENDENCY_PIN, exit class 4.

owner_points.point: A never-retried failure that competes with a first condition.
owner_points.ruling: It still ends the session with its own diagnostic frame; generation_end and the footer name the same code.

owner_points.id: Terminal code of two pending pipes
owner_points.point: When a frame and a status record are pending at one poll, which is read first decides the first terminal code.
owner_points.ruling: Logged as observed behaviour; the test row is deterministic.

owner_points.point: What validate-config's dependency check covers.
owner_points.ruling: The configuration and the five FOM modules against their pins and the XML scan; the worker is not probed there (observe's pre-flight does); the higher class wins.

owner_points.point: Exit of verify, inspect and export-capture for a faulty capture.
owner_points.ruling: 3 for every verdict other than COMPLETE whatever the fault's class (E_LIMIT and E_CONFIG faults included), 6 for an unreadable file; replay keeps its code's class.

owner_points.point: An offline command stopped by a signal.
owner_points.ruling: It stops at its next safe point, removes what it created and exits 130 or 143 with nothing printed; observe stops its session in order once one exists, and a stop during its own configuration and FOM pre-flight exits 130 or 143 like the other commands.

owner_points.point: What stderr carries.
owner_points.ruling: Refusals and terminal failures only; diagnostics that are records of the output are in diagnostics.jsonl and the summary, not repeated on stderr.

owner_points.point: A host whose parent has gone.
owner_points.ruling: Treated as an orderly stop request: the session ends in order and run.json is absent, which is the visible mark.

owner_points.point: SPEC:184 says forced termination cannot produce COMPLETE.
owner_points.ruling: Read as the command: a command killed from outside leaves a session the host ends in order (COMPLETE when the worker exited by itself) and no run.json; a parent gone before the first worker is FAILED E_RTI_CONNECT.

owner_points.point: The worker's parent dies.
owner_points.ruling: getppid() differing from the recorded parent, checked once per idle pause: resign NO_ACTION, disconnect, drain, exit 72, no report.

owner_points.point: The worker's diagnostic frames.
owner_points.ruling: object_token and attribute null, the failure record's text, enqueued when the queue has room, never for E_QUEUE_OVERFLOW.

owner_points.point: What the worker's queue bound counts.
owner_points.ruling: One bound of 4096 frames and 16 MiB of copied bytes covers the batch, the queue and the record being written; the refused record is the newest.

owner_points.point: Which code wins when a callback breaks several rules.
owner_points.ruling: Count, sizes (E_LIMIT), metadata validity (E_CAPTURE_SCHEMA), token budget, queue, in that order.

owner_points.point: A reflection or removal of a handle never discovered.
owner_points.ruling: It takes the next token, mapped as not active (E_UNKNOWN_OBJECT or W_DUPLICATE_REMOVE downstream); a later discovery is a new object with a new token.

owner_points.point: RTI exceptions without a code of their own.
owner_points.ruling: Mapped per service (connect, join, resolve, evoke, request, getAttributeName, resign, disconnect) to E_RTI_CONNECT, E_FEDERATE_NAME, E_FOM_PROFILE or E_CAPTURE_SCHEMA.

owner_points.point: When a failing resign or disconnect is reported.
owner_points.ruling: Immediately after the running record of that stage; the session ends FAILED E_RTI_CONNECT, no retry after a stop.

owner_points.point: What the demo accepts from the publisher.
owner_points.ruling: Twelve event kinds with exactly their members, printable ASCII lines of at most 768 bytes, R38's order; anything else fails the run with a fixed reason.

owner_points.point: An rtinode start ended by an exception.
owner_points.ruling: rtinode is ended by its PID before the exception leaves the start.

owner_points.point: Which class the publisher registered at.

owner_points.ruling: One more R14 deadline at most, then closed; a process the child left behind is not the demo's.

owner_points.ruling: Held by demo.schema.json where JSON Schema can express them (now also the seven steps by position) and by code and tests otherwise.

owner_points.point: R42's 1000 reflections per second against R44's per-upsert validation in pure Python.
owner_points.ruling: Per-upsert CDM validation with format checking stays; with external_elapsed the worker's queue overflowed on a 4-vCPU aarch64 machine in two of three R42-shaped runs and on the development Mac under load; the gate is BLOCKED (no x86_64 run) and at risk. owner_points.point: R44 names synapse-cdm 3.1.1 as the baseline; the package landed on 3.8.0 (schema 3.2.0).
owner_points.ruling: Recorded deviation: the dependency is synapse-cdm>=3.8.0,<4; the vendored 3.0.0 Entity schema stays the contract; the installed SDK's schema must be additive over it; the migration is recorded in the README.

owner_points.point: Byte identity across platforms: the specification's 1e-6 threshold is the unit of the difference seen between C libraries.
owner_points.ruling: Pins are per platform: darwin-arm64, recorded where Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.14 agreed, and linux-aarch64, recorded from one interpreter (Python 3.12.3, reference run ref-1 of 2026-10-25), so identity across interpreters on one platform, what each pin holds, is shown on darwin-arm64 and not observable on linux-aarch64; across platforms 674 of the 10,000 inputs differ in the last place of position_ecef_m (612 coordinate values by 1 ulp, 79 by 2 ulp) and 5 altitudes at 27,451 to 89,704 km differ by 1e-6 m.

owner_points.point: R05 asks for the source commit in every report; a report cannot name the commit that will contain it, and OPS-10 forbids fabricating one.
owner_points.ruling: Reports carry source_commit null; the evidence report names the base commit and the SHA-256 of the package's files, which identifies the tree.

owner_points.point: A SIGTERM in the milliseconds between the worker's spawn and the installation of its handler ends it by the signal, before its orderly stop exists (SPEC:277).
owner_points.ruling: No change: the host never spawns once a stop is requested, and a stop that lands in that window gives E_RTI_CONNECT with a FAILED footer, exit class 5, the outcome OPS-15 rules for a stop before the first join; closing the window needs native work (the spawn's signal mask).

owner_points.point: On macOS the OpenRTI build record spells its evidence line 'development evidence only (macOS: OpenRTI configured as C++98, NAT-02)', not CR-L04's label DEV-macOS-arm64.
owner_points.ruling: Kept as CR-R9-06 accepted it; the evidence report labels the native build DEV-macOS-arm64.

owner_points.point: The SBOM names the distribution pkg:pypi/synapse-hla@1.0.0 while it is released in the tag's tree and the release archives, not uploaded to the index (D-30).
owner_points.ruling: Kept: a pkg:pypi package URL names the ecosystem of a Python distribution, not an upload.

owner_points.point: OPS-11 refuses a failing worker pre-flight or a missing rtinode before the output directory exists; OPS-18 has the demo without rtinode write DIR/demo.json with status BLOCKED and exit 4.
owner_points.ruling: OPS-18 governs the demo: a missing or wrong rtinode, worker or publisher after the FOM check gives DIR/demo.json BLOCKED and exit 4 (CR-L16's reading for the publisher applies to all three); OPS-11's 'before the output directory exists' governs validate-config and observe; the FOM pin check precedes the directory for all three commands.

owner_points.point: A FOM module given as a symbolic link to the pinned bytes is accepted.
owner_points.ruling: The bytes decide (OPV-03, OPS-11): the pin is checked over the bytes read through the link.

owner_points.point: A SIGINT or SIGTERM before the program has installed its handlers (the interpreter's start-up) ends any command by the signal, with nothing started and nothing written.
owner_points.ruling: No change: before the handlers exist there is nothing of the product to stop; CR-R6-05's exit 130 or 143 applies from their installation on.

owner_points.point: The pre-flight 'sc-hla-federate --version' probe runs with the command's stderr: an executable named by SYNAPSE_HLA_WORKER that writes to stderr is heard there.
owner_points.ruling: Kept as CR-R5-04 rules (the worker's stderr is the host's): a misconfigured SYNAPSE_HLA_WORKER can put lines that are not JSON on stderr beside the E_DEPENDENCY_PIN diagnostic.
